verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a developer tool and registry service like npm, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the pack shows npm shipping an in-product assistant you can delegate tasks to. The only AI-related mention is a community remark about external LLM agents struggling with install settings, which is not a built-in capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
